# Patient RX System v3.0.7

## Dashboard and Call Center Lead-Window Alignment

- Fixes a remaining hard-coded seven-day Dashboard comparison.
- Dashboard Call Pre-Eligibility now uses Backoffice Call Center Lead Days.
- Call Center metric is labeled Call Queue to distinguish it from 90-day Service Eligible.
- No database migration or reset is required.

Deploy `server-update-3.0.7.zip`, preserve `.env`, restart the service, and refresh Dashboard and Call Center.
